segments.sn22.62:1.2: “Tayome, bhikkhave, niruttipathā adhivacanapathā paññattipathā asaṅkiṇṇā asaṅkiṇṇapubbā, na saṅkīyanti, na saṅkīyissanti, appaṭikuṭṭhā samaṇehi brāhmaṇehi viññūhi.
segments.sn22.62:1.4: Yaṃ, bhikkhave, rūpaṃ atītaṃ niruddhaṃ vipariṇataṃ ‘ahosī’ti tassa saṅkhā,‘ahosī’ti tassa samaññā,‘ahosī’ti tassa paññatti;
segments.sn22.62:1.5: na tassa saṅkhā ‘atthī’ti, na tassa saṅkhā ‘bhavissatī’”ti.
segments.sn22.62:2.1: “Yā vedanā atītā niruddhā vipariṇatā ‘ahosī’ti tassā saṅkhā,‘ahosī’ti tassā samaññā,‘ahosī’ti tassā paññatti;
segments.sn22.62:2.2: na tassā saṅkhā ‘atthī’ti, na tassā saṅkhā ‘bhavissatī’”ti.
segments.sn22.62:3.1: “Yā saññā … ye saṅkhārā atītā niruddhā vipariṇatā ‘ahesun’ti tesaṃ saṅkhā,‘ahesun’ti tesaṃ samaññā,‘ahesun’ti tesaṃ paññatti;
segments.sn22.62:3.3: na tesaṃ saṅkhā ‘atthī’ti, na tesaṃ saṅkhā ‘bhavissantī’”ti.
segments.sn22.62:4.1: “Yaṃ viññāṇaṃ atītaṃ niruddhaṃ vipariṇataṃ,‘ahosī’ti tassa saṅkhā,‘ahosī’ti tassa samaññā,‘ahosī’ti tassa paññatti;
segments.sn22.62:4.2: na tassa saṅkhā ‘atthī’ti, na tassa saṅkhā ‘bhavissatī’”ti.
segments.sn22.62:5.1: “Yaṃ, bhikkhave, rūpaṃ ajātaṃ apātubhūtaṃ,‘bhavissatī’ti tassa saṅkhā,‘bhavissatī’ti tassa samaññā,‘bhavissatī’ti tassa paññatti;
segments.sn22.62:5.2: na tassa saṅkhā ‘atthī’ti, na tassa saṅkhā ‘ahosī’”ti.
segments.sn22.62:6.1: “Yā vedanā ajātā apātubhūtā,‘bhavissatī’ti tassā saṅkhā,‘bhavissatī’ti tassā samaññā,‘bhavissatī’ti tassā paññatti;
segments.sn22.62:6.2: na tassā saṅkhā ‘atthī’ti, na tassā saṅkhā ‘ahosī’”ti.
segments.sn22.62:7.1: “Yā saññā … ye saṅkhārā ajātā apātubhūtā,‘bhavissantī’ti tesaṃ saṅkhā,‘bhavissantī’ti tesaṃ samaññā,‘bhavissantī’ti tesaṃ paññatti;
segments.sn22.62:7.3: na tesaṃ saṅkhā ‘atthī’ti, na tesaṃ saṅkhā ‘ahesun’”ti.
segments.sn22.62:8.1: “Yaṃ viññāṇaṃ ajātaṃ apātubhūtaṃ,‘bhavissatī’ti tassa saṅkhā,‘bhavissatī’ti tassa samaññā,‘bhavissatī’ti tassa paññatti;
segments.sn22.62:8.2: na tassa saṅkhā ‘atthī’ti, na tassa saṅkhā ‘ahosī’”ti.
segments.sn22.62:9.1: “Yaṃ, bhikkhave, rūpaṃ jātaṃ pātubhūtaṃ,‘atthī’ti tassa saṅkhā,‘atthī’ti tassa samaññā,‘atthī’ti tassa paññatti;
segments.sn22.62:9.2: na tassa saṅkhā ‘ahosī’ti, na tassa saṅkhā ‘bhavissatī’”ti.
segments.sn22.62:10.1: “Yā vedanā jātā pātubhūtā,‘atthī’ti tassā saṅkhā,‘atthī’ti tassā samaññā,‘atthī’ti tassā paññatti;
segments.sn22.62:10.2: na tassā saṅkhā ‘ahosī’ti, na tassā saṅkhā ‘bhavissatī’”ti.
segments.sn22.62:11.1: “Yā saññā … ye saṅkhārā jātā pātubhūtā,‘atthī’ti tesaṃ saṅkhā,‘atthī’ti tesaṃ samaññā,‘atthī’ti tesaṃ paññatti;
segments.sn22.62:11.3: na tesaṃ saṅkhā ‘ahesun’ti, na tesaṃ saṅkhā,‘bhavissantī’”ti.
segments.sn22.62:12.1: “Yaṃ viññāṇaṃ jātaṃ pātubhūtaṃ,‘atthī’ti tassa saṅkhā,‘atthī’ti tassa samaññā,‘atthī’ti tassa paññatti;
segments.sn22.62:12.2: na tassa saṅkhā ‘ahosī’ti, na tassa saṅkhā ‘bhavissatī’”ti.
segments.sn22.62:13.1: “Ime kho, bhikkhave, tayo niruttipathā adhivacanapathā paññattipathā asaṅkiṇṇā asaṅkiṇṇapubbā, na saṅkīyanti, na saṅkīyissanti, appaṭikuṭṭhā samaṇehi brāhmaṇehi viññūhi.
segments.sn22.62:13.2: Yepi te, bhikkhave, ahesuṃ ukkalā vassabhaññā [okkalā vayabhiññā (ma. ni.3.343)] ahetukavādā akiriyavādā natthikavādā, tepime tayo niruttipathe adhivacanapathe paññattipathe na garahitabbaṃ nappaṭikkositabbaṃ amaññiṃsu.
segments.sn22.62:13.4: Nindāghaṭṭanabyārosaupārambhabhayā”ti [nindābyārosaupārambhabhayāti (sī. syā. kaṃ. pī.) ma. ni.3.343].

lines: Dasame niruttiyova niruttipathā, atha vā niruttiyo ca tā niruttivasena viññātabbānaṃ atthānaṃ pathattā pathā cāti niruttipathā.
Tattha ime dve janā, tisso diṭṭhiyo, kiṃ ekekassa diyaḍḍhā hotīti?
Na tathā, yathā pana eko bhikkhu paṭipāṭiyā cattāripi jhānāni nibbatteti, evamettha ekeko tissopi diṭṭhiyo nibbattesīti veditabbo.
“Natthi hetu natthi paccayo”ti punappunaṃ āvajjentassa āharantassa abhinandantassa assādentassa maggadassanaṃ viya hoti.
So micchattaniyāmaṃ okkamati, so ekantakāḷakoti vuccati.
Yathā pana ahetukadiṭṭhiyaṃ, evaṃ “karoto na karīyati pāpaṃ, natthi dinnan”ti imesupi ṭhānesu micchattaniyāmaṃ okkamati.
Na garahitabbaṃ nappaṭikkositabbaṃ amaññiṃsūti ettha “yadetaṃ atītaṃ nāma, nayidaṃ atītaṃ, idamassa anāgataṃ vā paccuppannaṃ vā”ti vadanto garahati nāma.
Ime pana niruttipathe tepi accantakāḷakā diṭṭhigatikā na garahitabbe na paṭikkositabbe maññiṃsu.
Atītaṃ pana atītameva, anāgataṃ anāgatameva, paccuppannaṃ paccuppannameva kathayiṃsu.
Nindāghaṭṭanabyārosaupārambhabhayāti viññūnaṃ santikā nindābhayena ca ghaṭṭanabhayena ca dosāropanabhayena ca upārambhabhayena ca.
Iti imasmiṃ sutte catubhūmikakhandhānaṃ paṇṇatti kathitāti.

Tathā hi “phusatīti phasso”tiādinā nīharitvā vacanaṃ nirutti,“sirīvaḍḍhako dhanavaḍḍhako”tiādinā vacanamattameva adhikāraṃ katvā pavattaṃ adhivacanaṃ,“takko vitakko”tiādinā taṃtaṃpakārena ñāpanato paññatti.
Atha vā taṃtaṃatthappakāsanena nicchitaṃ, niyataṃ vā vacanaṃ nirutti.
Atthassa paññāpanatthena paññattīti evaṃ niruttiādipadānaṃ sabbavacanesu pavatti veditabbā.
Aññathā “phusatīti phasso”tiādippakārena niddhāraṇavacanānaṃyeva niruttitā, sirivaḍḍhakadhanavaḍḍhakapakārānameva abhilāpanaṃ adhivacanatā.
“Takko vitakko”ti evaṃpakārānameva ekameva atthaṃ tena tena pakārena ñāpentānaṃ vacanānaṃ paññattitā ca āpajjeyya.
Na saṃkīyantīti na saṃkirīyanti, na saṃkīyissanti na saṃkirīyissantīti attho.
Yasmā bhaṅgaṃ atikkantaṃ uppādādi atikkantameva hoti, tasmā vuttaṃ “bhaṅgamevā”ti.
Yasmā desantaraṃ saṅkantopi atikkantanti vuccati, tasmā tadābhāvaṃ dassetuṃ “desantaraṃ asaṅkamitvā”ti vuttaṃ.
Yattha yattha hi saṅkhārā uppajjanti, tattha tattheva bhijjanti nirujjhanti vipariṇamanti vināsaṃ āpajjanti.
Mūladiṭṭhigatikāti mūlabhūtā diṭṭhigatikā, imasmiṃ kappe sabbapaṭhamaṃ tādisadiṭṭhisamuppādakā.

Punappunaṃ āvajjentassāti ahetuvādapaṭisaṃyuttaganthaṃ uggahetvā pariyāpuṇitvā tadatthaṃ vīmaṃsantassa “natthi hetu, natthi paccayo sattānaṃ saṃkilesāyā”tiādinayappavattāya laddhiyā ārammaṇe micchāsati santiṭṭhati,“natthi hetū”tiādivasena anussavūpaladdhe atthe tadākāraparivitakkanehi saviggahe viya sarūpato cittassa paccupaṭṭhite cirakālaparicayena “evametan”ti nijjhānakkhamabhāvūpagamanena nijjhānakkhantiyā tathāgahite punappunaṃ tatheva āsevantassa bahulīkarontassa micchāvitakkena samādiyamānā micchāvāyāmūpatthambhitā ataṃsabhāvaṃ “taṃsabhāvan”ti gaṇhantī micchāsatīti laddhanāmā taṃladdhisahagatā taṇhā santiṭṭhati.
Yathāsakaṃ vitakkādipaccayalābhena tasmiṃ ārammaṇe adhiṭṭhitatāya anekaggataṃ pahāya cittaṃ ekaggataṃ appitaṃ viya hoti micchāsamādhinā.
Sopi hi paccayavisesehi laddhabhāvanābalo īdise ṭhāne samādhānapatirūpakiccakaro hotiyeva vālavijjhanādīsu viyāti daṭṭhabbaṃ.
Tathā hi anekakkhattuṃ tenākārena pubbabhāgiyesu javanavāresu pavattesu sabbapacchime javanavāre satta javanāni javanti.
Tattha paṭhame satekiccho hoti, tathā dutiyādīsu.
Sattame pana javane sampatte atekiccho hoti.
Tena “yadetaṃ anāgataṃ nāma, nayidaṃ anāgatan”tiādikaṃ saṅgaṇhāti.
